        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for sightings based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality to efficiently compute stats\n */\nexport async function getSightingsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n): Promise\u003c{\n\ttotalSightings: number;\n\tbyType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\tbyYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\tbyLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\ttimeRange: {\n\t\tstartYear: number;\n\t\tendYear: number;\n\t};\n}\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's summarize for shape distribution\n\t\t// @ts-ignore - Xata API types may need updating\n\t\tconst shapesAggregation: XataAggregationResult =\n\t\t\tawait xata.db.sightings.summarize({\n\t\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\tcolumns: [\"shape\"],\n\t\t\t\tsummaries: {\n\t\t\t\t\tshapeCount: { count: \"*\" },\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Summarize for time series data by year\n\t\t// @ts-ignore - Xata API types may need updating\n\t\tconst timeSeriesAggregation: XataAggregationResult =\n\t\t\tawait xata.db.sightings.summarize({\n\t\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\tcolumns: [\"date\"],\n\t\t\t\tsummaries: {\n\t\t\t\t\tyearCount: { count: \"*\" },\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Summarize by location\n\t\t// @ts-ignore - Xata API types may need updating\n\t\tconst locationAggregation: XataAggregationResult =\n\t\t\tawait xata.db.sightings.summarize({\n\t\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\tcolumns: [\"city\"],\n\t\t\t\tsummaries: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcityCount: { count: \"*\" },\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Process and return the aggregated data\n\t\tconst yearCounts = timeSeriesAggregation.summaries?.yearCount || {};\n\t\tlet totalSightings = 0;\n\n\t\t// Calculate total sightings\n\t\tObject.values(yearCounts).forEach((count) =\u003e {\n\t\t\ttotalSightings += count;\n\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\ttotalSightings,\n\t\t\tbyType: shapesAggregation.summaries?.shapeCount || {},\n\t\t\tbyYear: yearCounts,\n\t\t\tbyLocation: locationAggregation.summaries?.cityCount || {},\n\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\tstartYear,\n\t\t\t\tendYear,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching sightings stats:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\ttotalSightings: 0,\n\t\t\tbyType: {},\n\t\t\tbyYear: {},\n\t\t\tbyLocation: {},\n\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\tstartYear,\n\t\t\t\tendYear,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for sightings based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality to efficiently compute stats\n */\nexport async function getSightingsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n): Promise\u003c{\n\ttotalSightings: number;\n\tbyType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\tbyYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\tbyLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\ttimeRange: {\n\t\tstartYear: number;\n\t\tendYear: number;\n\t};\n}\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's summarize for shape distribution\n\t\t// @ts-ignore - Xata API types may need updating\n\t\tconst timeSeriesAggregation: XataAggregationResult =\n\t\t\tawait xata.db.sightings.summarize({\n\t\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\tcolumns: [\"date\"],\n\t\t\t\tsummaries: {\n\t\t\t\t\tyearCount: { count: \"*\" },\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Summarize by location\n\t\t// @ts-ignore - Xata API types may need updating\n\t\tconst locationAggregation: XataAggregationResult =\n\t\t\tawait xata.db.sightings.summarize({\n\t\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\tcolumns: [\"city\"],\n\t\t\t\tsummaries: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcityCount: { count: \"*\" },\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Process and return the aggregated data\n\t\tconst yearCounts = timeSeriesAggregation.summaries?.yearCount || {};\n\t\tlet totalSightings = 0;\n\n\t\t// Calculate total sightings\n\t\tObject.values(yearCounts).forEach((count) =\u003e {\n\t\t\ttotalSightings += count;\n\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\ttotalSightings,\n\t\t\tbyType: shapesAggregation.summaries?.shapeCount || {},\n\t\t\tbyYear: yearCounts,\n\t\t\tbyLocation: locationAggregation.summaries?.cityCount || {},\n\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\tstartYear,\n\t\t\t\tendYear,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching sightings stats:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\ttotalSightings: 0,\n\t\t\tbyType: {},\n\t\t\tbyYear: {},\n\t\t\tbyLocation: {},\n\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\tstartYear,\n\t\t\t\tendYear,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n    // Create system prompt for OpenAI\n    const systemPrompt = &#96;You are an expert data analyst specializing in UFO/UAP sightings analysis. \n    Analyze the provided UFO sightings data to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies. \n    Focus on the following aspects:\n    1. Geographic clusters and hotspots\n    2. Temporal patterns (time of day, seasonal variations)\n    3. Object shape and behavior patterns\n    4. Notable anomalies or outliers\n    5. Potential correlations with military bases or other points of interest\n    \n    Provide a thorough analysis with both general insights and specific observations.&#96;;\n\n    // Create user prompt with the sightings data\n    const userPrompt = &#96;Analyze the following UFO sightings data and provide structured insights:\\n\\n${JSON.stringify(sightingsSummary, null, 2)}&#96;;\n\n    // Create streamable value for incremental updates\n    const stream = createStreamableValue();\n\n    // Make the OpenAI API call with streaming\n    const { partialObjectStream } = await streamObject({\n      model: openai.responses(\"gpt-4-turbo-preview\"), // Using a more capable model for analysis\n      system: systemPrompt,\n      prompt: userPrompt,\n      schema: analysisSchema,\n    });\n\n    console.log(\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ API call initiated\");\n\n    // Process the streaming response\n    for await (const partialObject of partialObjectStream) {\n      console.log(\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ partialObject update:\", \n        Object.keys(partialObject).length);\n      stream.update(partialObject);\n    }\n\n    stream.done;\n    \n    // Return both the analysis and the streaming value\n    return { \n      analysis: stream.value as SightingsAnalysisResult,\n      streamingValue: stream \n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"Error analyzing sightings data:\", error);\n    throw new Error(&#96;Failed to analyze sightings data: ${error.message}&#96;);\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */\nexport async function getEventsStats(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear()\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's aggregate to get category distribution\n    const categoryAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        categoryDistribution: {\n          distinctCount: {\n            column: 'id',\n            groupBy: 'category'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    \n    // Get time series data by year\n    const timeSeriesAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        eventsByYear: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: {\n              dateColumn: 'date',\n              method: 'byYear'\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    // Aggregate by location\n    const locationAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        eventsByLocation: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: 'location'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    return {\n      total: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear.reduce(\n        (sum, item) =\u003e sum + item.count, 0\n      ),\n      categoryDistribution: categoryAggregation.aggs.categoryDistribution,\n      timeseriesData: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear,\n      locationData: locationAggregation.aggs.eventsByLocation,\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events stats:', error);\n    return {\n      total: 0,\n      categoryDistribution: [],\n      timeseriesData: [],\n      locationData: [],\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */\nexport async function getEventsStats(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear()\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's aggregate to get category distribution\n    const categoryAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        categoryDistribution: {\n          distinctCount: {\n            column: 'id',\n            groupBy: 'category'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    \n    // Get time series data by year\n    const timeSeriesAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        eventsByYear: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: {\n              dateColumn: 'date',\n              method: 'byYear'\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    // Aggregate by location\n    const locationAggregation = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        eventsByLocation: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: 'location'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    return {\n      total: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear.reduce(\n        (sum, item) =\u003e sum + item.count, 0\n      ),\n      categoryDistribution: categoryAggregation.aggs.categoryDistribution,\n      timeseriesData: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear,\n      locationData: locationAggregation.aggs.eventsByLocation,\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events stats:', error);\n    return {\n      total: 0,\n      categoryDistribution: [],\n      timeseriesData: [],\n      locationData: [],\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\"use server\";\n\nimport { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n    const eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });\n\n    return eventsRecords.records;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# Aggregations\n\nStarting with January 10, 2025, this functionality will no longer be part of the Free plan. It will continue to be available as documented to users on the Pro and Enterprises plans. For more details see this blog post.\n\nThe /aggregate API allows you to use the search/analytics engine to perform aggregations on your data. Similar to the search API aggregations run in the optional Search store, which means: it is eventually consistent with the main transactional store, and it cannot access the linked fields from a table. The Search store is enabled by default and can be disabled in the Database Settings from the Web UI. The aggregate API and features described in this page require the Search store to be enabled. If these limitations are not acceptable for your use case, you should use the Summarize API. The advantages of using the Aggregation API, over the Summarize API, are:\n\nit generally offers better performance, because the underlying store is column oriented.\nit offers composable aggregations that can be combined into complex aggregations / visualizations.\nOperations which are available both in the Aggregation and the Summarize API, such as sum, may present small deviations due to differences in the order of reading data from storage and subsequent rounding, as well as in case of in-flight data until consistency is achieved across the different stores.\n\nAn example of a relatively complex visualization that can be created with the Aggregation API could be: a multi-line chart, where each line represents a movie genre, and the Y axis represents the average rating of the movies in that genre, per year.         "contents": "\nexport const executePlatformWideConnectionSearch = async ( { id, type }: any ) =\u003e {\n  const tables: any = connectionMapByEntityType[type]\n\n  const { totalCount, records } = await xata.search.all( &#96;${id}&#96;, {\n    tables: tables.map(\n      ( { table, target }: { table: string; target: string } ) =\u003e {\n        return {\n          table: &#96;${table}&#96;,\n          target: [{ column: &#96;${target}&#96;, weight: 10 }],\n        }\n      }\n    ),\n    fuzziness: 0,\n    prefix: 'phrase',\n  } )\n\n  const connectionRecords: Set\u003cany\u003e = new Set()\n\n  for ( const item of records ) {\n    const { record, table } = item\n    if ( table === 'testimonies' ) {\n      console.log( 'record: ', record )\n      const connection: any = await xata.db.testimonies.read( record?.id, ['*', 'event.*', 'witness.*'] )\n      if ( !connectionRecords.has( connection ) ) {\n        connectionRecords.add( {\n          ...connection,\n          type: 'testimonies',\n\n          // connectionTable,\n        } )\n\n      }\n    } else {\n      const originalRecordTypeSingular = objectMapToSingular[type]\n      const {\n        record: { xata: xataObject, ...restOfRecord },\n        table: connectionTable,\n      }: any = item\n\n      if (\n        restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular] \u0026\u0026\n        restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular].id === id\n      ) {\n        delete restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular]\n      }\n      const { id: recordId, ...rest } = restOfRecord\n\n      const [connectionType] = Object.keys( rest )\n\n      const table: any = objectMapPlural[connectionType]\n\n      const connectedRecordId = rest[connectionType].id\n\n      const connection: any = await xata.db[table].read( connectedRecordId )\n\n      if ( !connectionRecords.has( connection ) ) {\n        connectionRecords.add( {\n          ...connection,\n          type: table,\n          connectionTableId: recordId,\n          connectionTable,\n        } )\n      }\n\n    }\n\n\n    //  await xata.db[table].read( record?.id )\n    // console.log( 'connection: ', connection )\n\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch sightings within a specified time chunk using Xata's aggregate functionality\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getSightingsByTimeChunk(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n\tlimit = 100,\n): Promise\u003cValidatedUAPSighting[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's filter to get sightings within date range\n\t\t// @ts-ignore - Xata API types may need updating\n\n\t\tconst sightingsRecords = await xata.db.sightings\n\t\t\t.filter({\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.sort(\"date\", \"desc\")\n\t\t\t.getPaginated({\n\t\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\t\tsize: limit,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\t\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ sightingsRecords:\", sightingsRecords);\n\n\t\t// Convert to ValidatedUAPSighting format\n\t\tconst sightings = sightingsRecords.records\n\t\t\t.map((record: XataRecord) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t// Transform from Xata format to UAPSighting format\n\t\t\t\tconst transformed = {\n\t\t\t\t\tid: record.id,\n\t\t\t\t\tsource: \"news\", // Default source\n\t\t\t\t\ttitle: record.description?.substring(0, 50) || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\t\t\tcontent: record.description || \"\",\n\t\t\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcity: record.city || undefined,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tstate: record.state,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\trecord.latitude \u0026\u0026 record.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t? {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlat: record.latitude,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlng: record.longitude,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\ttimestamp: record.date || new Date(),\n\t\t\t\t\tmediaUrls: record.media_link ? [record.media_link] : [],\n\t\t\t\t\tsourceUrl: record.media_link || \"\",\n\t\t\t\t\tcategory: record.shape ? [record.shape] : [],\n\t\t\t\t\tconfidence: \"medium\", // Default confidence\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\", // Default type\n\t\t\t\t};\n\n\t\t\t\t// Validate with schema\n\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn UAPSightingSchema.parse(transformed);\n\t\t\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\t\t\tconsole.error(\"Schema validation error:\", error);\n\t\t\t\t\treturn null;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.filter(Boolean) as ValidatedUAPSighting[];\n\n\t\treturn sightings;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching sightings by time chunk:\", error);\n\t\treturn [];\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch a paginated batch of sightings data with time ranges\n * @param timeRanges Array of time ranges to query\n * @param limit Maximum records per time range\n */\nexport async function getSightingsBatched(\n\ttimeRanges: { startYear: number; endYear: number }[],\n\tlimit = 50,\n): Promise\u003c{\n\tsightings: ValidatedUAPSighting[];\n\tstats: {\n\t\ttotalSightings: number;\n\t\tbyType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\t\tbyYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\t\tbyLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\tstartYear: number;\n\t\t\tendYear: number;\n\t\t};\n\t};\n}\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Process batches in parallel\n\t\tconst batchPromises = timeRanges.map((range) =\u003e\n\t\t\tgetSightingsByTimeChunk(range.startYear, range.endYear, limit),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Stats for the full range\n\t\tconst startYear = Math.min(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.startYear));\n\t\tconst endYear = Math.max(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.endYear));\n\t\tconst statsPromise = getSightingsStats(startYear, endYear);\n\n\t\t// Wait for all promises to resolve\n\t\tconst [batchResults, stats] = await Promise.all([\n\t\t\tPromise.all(batchPromises),\n\t\t\tstatsPromise,\n\t\t]);\n\n\t\t// Merge all batches\n\t\tconst allSightings = batchResults.flat();\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: allSightings,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching batched sightings:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: [],\n\t\t\tstats: {\n\t\t\t\ttotalSightings: 0,\n\t\t\t\tbyType: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyYear: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyLocation: {},\n\t\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\t\tstartYear: timeRanges[0]?.startYear || 1940,\n\t\t\t\t\tendYear:\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttimeRanges[timeRanges.length - 1]?.endYear ||\n\t\t\t\t\t\tnew Date().getFullYear(),\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch a paginated batch of sightings data with time ranges\n * @param timeRanges Array of time ranges to query\n * @param limit Maximum records per time range\n */\nexport async function getSightingsBatched(\n\ttimeRanges: { startYear: number; endYear: number }[],\n\tlimit = 50,\n): Promise\u003c{\n\tsightings: ValidatedUAPSighting[];\n\tstats: {\n\t\ttotalSightings: number;\n\t\tbyType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\t\tbyYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\t\tbyLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\tstartYear: number;\n\t\t\tendYear: number;\n\t\t};\n\t};\n}\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Process batches in parallel\n\t\tconst batchPromises = timeRanges.map((range) =\u003e\n\t\t\tgetSightingsByTimeChunk(range.startYear, range.endYear, limit),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Stats for the full range\n\t\tconst startYear = Math.min(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.startYear));\n\t\tconst endYear = Math.max(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.endYear));\n\t\tconst statsPromise = getSightingsStats(startYear, endYear);\n\n\t\t// Wait for all promises to resolve\n\t\tconst [batchResults, stats] = await Promise.all([\n\t\t\tPromise.all(batchPromises),\n\t\t\tstatsPromise,\n\t\t]);\n\n\t\t// Merge all batches\n\t\tconst allSightings = batchResults.flat();\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: allSightings,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching batched sightings:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: [],\n\t\t\tstats: {\n\t\t\t\ttotalSightings: 0,\n\t\t\t\tbyType: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyYear: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyLocation: {},\n\t\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\t\tstartYear: timeRanges[0]?.startYear || 1940,\n\t\t\t\t\tendYear:\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttimeRanges[timeRanges.length - 1]?.endYear ||\n\t\t\t\t\t\tnew Date().getFullYear(),\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

3. Falls back to the batch approach only when non-contiguous time ranges are provided

This approach maintains flexibility while significantly improving performance for the common case of querying a continuous date range.

For testing, I recommend trying these changes and checking your debug logs - you should see the system using the "optimized single query approach" rather than multiple parallel queries. This should fix your data fetching issues while also making your application more efficient.

_**User (2025-04-04 00:53:48Z)**_

Should be implementing @Xata Typescript  #DataHistogram
```
dateHistogram is a bucket-aggregation that splits the data into buckets by a timestamptz (datetime) column. It is configured with the following parameters:

column: The column to use for bucketing. Must be of type timestamptz (datetime).
interval: The fixed interval to use when bucketing. It is formatted as number + unit of time, for example: 5d, 20m, 10s.
calendarInterval: The calendar-aware interval to use when bucketing. Possible values are: minute, hour, day, week, month, quarter, year.
timezone: The timezone to use for bucketing. By default, UTC is assumed. The accepted format is as an ISO 8601 UTC offset. For example: +01:00 or -08:00.
aggs: sub-aggregations to execute on the resulting buckets.
Either interval or calendarInterval must be specified. The calendarInterval always starts at the boundary of the calendar unit, for example, if the calendarInterval is month, the buckets will start at the beginning of the month.

Example:

TypeScript
Python
JSON
const records = await xata.db.titles.aggregate({
  byReleaseDate: {
    dateHistogram: {
      column: "releaseDate",
      calendarInterval: "year",
    },
  },
});
